# Official Image Sources for APXInf

This directory only retains two official diagrams used in the tutorial text. Both come from the APXInf project introduction page of Wuwenxinqiong:

| File | Purpose | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apxinf-figure-1.png` | Hierarchical structure of Python interface, Rust Runtime, high-performance operator library, and hardware backend | [APXInf official introduction](https://www.infinigence-ai.com/news-updates/233.html) |
| `apxinf-figure-2.png` | Analysis of π0.5 latency optimization on Jetson AGX Thor | [APXInf official introduction](https://www.infinigence-ai.com/news-updates/233.html) |

The tutorial uses images as teaching materials to explain the source of the data; the performance numbers in the images should still be based on the official repository of the corresponding version and actual hardware testing.
